name: doggybank
description: A poker arena for independently hosted strategy bots.

scripts.setup: uv sync --all-packages --group check && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.test:server: uv run --all-packages --group test python -m unittest discover -s apps/server/tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @doggybank/web exec react-router typegen && vp check && pnpm --filter @doggybank/web check && pnpm check:server && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:workflows
scripts.check:server: uv run --all-packages --group check --group test ruff format --check && uv run --all-packages --group check --group test ruff check && uv run --all-packages --group check --group test ty check
